g.text: QuantWare VIO-40K: 3D Chiplet Superconducting QPU Architecture
10,000 Physical Qubits, 40,000 Vertical TSV Cryo-I/O Lines, and Hybrid NVIDIA NVQLink / CUDA-Q Stack
• Wiring perimeter scales as O(√N), area O(N)
• Heavy microwave crosstalk between trace lines
• Thermal heat load exceeds dilution capacity at 15 mK
Zero planar edge routing choke points
Surface Code Distance d=7: ~100 Logical Qubits
Die Footprint: Smaller than 100-qubit planar die
Scaling to 1M qubits via modular multi-QPU mesh
• PCIe Gen5 / NVQLink fiber optical host bridges
• 20 dB microwave attenuators for drive lines
• Heat sinking: removes 1.5 W baseline load
• Infrared Eccosorb filters absorb stray photons
• Dilution cooling capacity: ~20 µW at 15 mK
TSV routing minimizes parasitic heat load
Dephasing Time T2*: > 35 µs (flux noise / TLS loss)
• IQ microwave mixer calibration & pulse shaping
Streams 40k channel bitstrings to Tensor Cores
Calculates minimum error chains in ~300 ns
Transmits correction pulse before T2 dephasing
